description: Merged PRO tests from ALL 22 matrix jobs. These returned 402 Payment Required when attempted with free (guest) cookies. They require a RepeaterMock PRO subscription. Sources: per-job PRO_TESTS.json (primary) + per-job progress.json 'pro' key (fallback for missing test_ids only).
how_to_use: 1. Log in to repeatermock.com with a PRO subscription account
2. Copy any URL from pro_tests[].attempt_url below
3. Paste it in your browser's address bar
4. Or use the plain-text list in PRO_LINKS.txt for bulk copy-paste
